svg.title: Figure 5 · TSR blocks × safety goals
svg.text: Figure 5 · Where each safety goal lands: TSR blocks × goals
Cell = TSRs in the block that trace up to the goal through their parents. A TSR serving several goals counts in each column.
Block names are the WP-S-02 section titles. “No goal”: TSRs whose parents reach no safety goal (operation requirements in 8xx, for example).
